producer_report.summary: athena status now evaluates the job-planning keep rule (section 9, D110). A new keep_rule() in status.rs counts planned jobs, landed jobs, the landed share, cost per landed job and the first-round accept rate, and gives a verdict of keep, breach, turn_off or inconclusive. It is in StatusView as keep_rule, so --json carries it. Status text prints the measures and a BREACH line with numbers when the verdict is breach or turn_off. Tests were added in both crates, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry. The first-round check was pulled into a shared helper so status and the rule agree. Planning is never turned off by this; it only reports.

checks_run.note: 5 keep_rule tests pass after fixing my fixture ids and cost figures

criteria_check.criterion: A status.rs unit test builds fixture records with 51 planned dispatched jobs, 28 landed, and asserts the measures (landed 28, planned 51, share about 0.549, cost per landed job, first-round accept rate) and a breach verdict because the share is below 0.64. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: keep_rule_flags_28_landed_of_51_planned_as_a_breach_with_the_measures passes; asserts 51/28, share, cost 51/28, first-round 20/51, Breach.

criteria_check.criterion: Fixture tests cover the rule's branches: at most 30 planned jobs with share at or above 0.64 reads keep; below 0.64 reads breach; at 100 or more planned jobs, share at least 0.72 with cost per landed job at most $2.50 reads keep, share at or below 0.64 reads turn off, otherwise inconclusive; zero landed gives no division by zero. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.

A display.rs test shows the rendered status text contains the measures with their numbers (28 of 51, 55%, baseline 64%, cost per landed job, first-round accept rate) and a breach line when breached, and no breach line when kept. Run: cargo test -p athena-cli.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p athena-cli keep_rule: keep_rule_lines_show_the_measures_and_a_breach_line_only_when_breached passes. It tests keep_rule_lines, which status() calls, not a whole StatusView.

criteria_check.criterion: The StatusView serialization (what `athena status --json` prints) contains a keep-rule object with the measures and verdict; a test asserts the JSON keys and values. Run: cargo test.
criteria_check.evidence: StatusView.keep_rule is a serialized Option<KeepRule>; the 51-job test asserts the JSON keys planned, landed, baseline_share, verdict=breach, share, cost and rate. Key test is on KeepRule, the field's type.

criteria_check.criterion: The denominator counts planned dispatched jobs, a job stopped in planning counts as not landed, and cost per landed job divides all cost of those jobs by landed jobs, as section 9 defines it; the thresholds (30, 100, 64%, 72%, $2.50) are named constants citing job-planning.md section 9 and D110.
criteria_check.evidence: keep_rule() in status.rs and the KEEP_RULE_* constants with doc comments citing section 9 and D110; a test covers a stopped job with no dispatch record.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the keep-rule evaluation in status.
cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full cargo test and fmt --check; I ran clippy with -D warnings (clean) and ran cargo fmt --all.
